release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (VDC_240_VDN_240_Data_sheet_enUS_1991380747.pdf, V8 2015). Suffix -1 = PAL (752x582), -2 = NTSC (768x494), H = heater version (17.5 W max, operating temperature -30 to 50 C vs 6 W / -10 to 50 C without heater). Datasheet sensitivity is not stated at a specific IRE level. Analog camera: no network/RTSP.
